scripts.mobile:run:android: node tools/mobile-preflight.mjs android && pnpm mobile:sync && cap run android

scripts.mobile:dev:android: node tools/mobile-preflight.mjs android && CAPACITOR_SERVER_URL=http://10.0.2.2:3000 cap run android
